description: ground_concern's 7-way ordered if/elif over relation heads (reflective_faculty.py :1584-1607: comprehend -> utility -> group -> control -> {communicate,decompose} -> construct -> distribute) as DATA: 8 ComposerCue nodes (communicate/decompose share priority 5, both -> the 'communicate' composer, matching the old chain position) + a stored Program 'composer_pick' that, given the grounded relation-head SET (env: heads), returns the highest-priority (lowest-number) matching composer name via Argmin -- the ordered-chain semantics preserved as priority data, not a Python if/elif. EXTENDED (self-experiment path): 4 more ComposerCue nodes (test/vary/send/judge, priorities 8-11, all -> the 'experiment' composer) so a self-experiment concern -- deciding to test a hypothesis about itself by dispatching a modified instance, then judging the result -- dispatches the SAME way; lowest priority among whichever of test/vary/send/judge grounded still always resolves to 'experiment'. EXTENDED AGAIN (browse-affordance-choice path): 1 more ComposerCue (relation_head 'match', priority 12, -> the 'browse' composer) so a content-relevance decision concern (choosing which Affordance to act on by overlap with a held Goal's wanted words) dispatches to its own composer -- distinct from 'decision' (priority 2, grid-navigation shape: avatar_candidate/cy/cx/drow/dcol) because BrowserSession/Element/Affordance carry no position/candidate vocabulary at all; 'utility' alone still resolves to 'decision' (lower priority, unchanged), so an ungrounded browsing concern that only matches 'utility' still hits the WRONG (grid) composer -- 'match' is the cue that routes it correctly. EXTENDED AGAIN (self-varying delta path): 1 more ComposerCue (relation_head 'embed', priority 13, -> the 'experiment' composer) so the DISTINCT concern of actually CONSTRUCTING and carrying a modified rule onto a dispatched copy -- as opposed to 'vary' alone, which only flags the delta as intentional and picks WHICH seed to ablate via an Argmax over SeedSummary provenance nodes -- routes to the same composer too; a concern grounding only test/vary/send/judge (no 'embed') still produces a delta with add_rules:'[]' (the pre-existing, back-compatible shape), while one that also grounds 'embed' gets a genuine threshold-shifted variant rule embedded. EXTENDED AGAIN (attention/when-to-look path): 1 more ComposerCue (relation_head 'watch', priority 14, -> the 'attention' composer) so a perception-timing concern ('when to sample my own eye') dispatches to its own composer -- no held cue (watch/observe/look/perceive/attend/notice) existed before this change (checked: none of the 39 prior RelationCue keyword lists mention any of them), a genuine wall, not a re-label of an existing composer. EXTENDED AGAIN (grounding-guard / confident-wrong-outside-its-range path): 1 more ComposerCue (relation_head 'escalate', priority 17, -> the new 'grounding_guard' composer) so a confident-but-ungrounded concern (domains/grounding_reach.py's GroundingGap flag: low residual + high confidence + grounding_reach(node).reached is False) dispatches to its own composer -- checked: no held cue's keywords covered escalate/ungrounded/reground/anchor-reachability before this change, the same genuine-wall shape 'watch' was; 'escalate' does not collide with any prior grounded relation_head, so this is a pure addition, no re-priority of the existing chain. EXTENDED AGAIN (dual-process arbitration / cost-worth-refining path): 1 more ComposerCue (relation_head 'worth', priority 18, -> the new 'escalation_gate' composer) so the OTHER escalation arm -- a grounded, currently-frontier-picked CapabilityAxis whose residual*value exceeds its refinement cost (seeds/residual_salience.json's cost_salience formula, read not re-derived) -- dispatches to its own composer, orthogonal to 'escalate'/grounding_guard (which fires on ungrounded-confident instead): checked, no held cue's keywords covered worth/refine-when-worth-it before this change, a genuine wall like 'watch' and 'escalate' were; 'worth' collides with nothing prior, pure addition. EXTENDED AGAIN (tier-3 imagination-on-escalation path): 1 more ComposerCue (relation_head 'imagine', priority 19, -> the new 'imagination' composer) so the concern of running the collapse DETACHED from the external reference frame (a counterfactual, once active cognition has already been engaged by either escalation arm) dispatches to its own composer -- checked, no held cue's keywords covered imagine/counterfactual/suppose/simulate before this change, the same genuine-wall shape 'watch'/'escalate'/'worth' were; 'imagine' collides with nothing prior, pure addition. EXTENDED AGAIN (tier-4 meta-collapse-cognition path): 1 more ComposerCue (relation_head 'predict', priority 20, -> the new 'collapse_watch' composer) so the concern of the graph modelling its OWN total collapse (domains/collapse_model.py's CollapseModel: fixed points, volatile frontier, converged/diverged) dispatches to its own composer -- checked, no held cue's keywords covered predict/foresee/converge/diverge before this change, the same genuine-wall shape 'watch'/'escalate'/'worth'/'imagine' were; 'predict' collides with nothing prior, pure addition. EXTENDED AGAIN (tier-5 system-model-of-another/model-of-modelling path): 1 more ComposerCue (relation_head 'regard', priority 22, -> the new 'system_model' composer) so the concern of the graph modelling an ARBITRARY target system (domains/system_model.py's SystemModel: another foreign system observed and grounded, OR the graph's own collapse-modelling machinery one tier up) dispatches to its own composer -- checked, no held cue's keywords covered regard/model-another/theory-of-mind/own-modelling before this change, the same genuine-wall shape 'watch'/'escalate'/'worth'/'imagine'/'predict' were; 'regard' collides with nothing prior, pure addition. EXTENDED AGAIN (audience-driven-production decision path): 1 more ComposerCue (relation_head 'tailor', priority 23, -> the new 'audience_produce' composer) so the concern of DECIDING how to produce an utterance for a specific audience (domains/audience_driven_production.py: model the audience, then tailor-if-grounded / fall back to explicit-if-ungrounded) dispatches to its own composer -- checked, no held cue's keywords covered tailor/audience-tailored/produce-for-audience before this change, the same genuine-wall shape 'watch'/'escalate'/'worth'/'imagine'/'predict'/'regard' were; 'tailor' collides with nothing prior, pure addition.

microtheory.name: composer_dispatch
microtheory.description: which composer builds a rule for a grounded concern, ranked by ComposerCue.priority.

attrs.note: tranche 7: a 'replay' head is only grounded by the conversation-experiment bundle, so it is a conversation experiment by construction; it outranks communicate (5), whose cue keywords substring-match ordinary content words in reported concerns ('speaker' contains 'speak'). tranche 21: priority 0.5 -- outranks every composer; a comprehension concern's own content words ground 'comprehend' (1), which had sent it to the comprehension composer (inert rule, no experiment). A concern already routed to the experiment pipeline is not re-routed by its content.
